question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Proficient
solution:
The correct answer is '**Skilful**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Proficient**' is used to describe someone skilled in doing or using something very well, especially through training or experience. (निपुण)

 
 
• **Example**: She became **proficient **in French over the years she spent in France.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym here is '**skilful**'. '**Skilful**' refers to having or showing skill. (कुशल)
 
 
• **Example**: He is so **skilful **that he can paint with both hands.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**proficient**' is '**skilful**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: '**Condensed**' primarily means to make (something) denser or more concentrated. (संक्षिप्त)
 
• Option 2: '**Inadequate**' is directly opposed in meaning to 'proficient', as it means not good enough or too small in amount. (अपर्याप्त)
 
• Option 3: '**Vulgar**' means lacking refinement or taste; coarse. (अशिष्ट)
